'''KypDuron Training & Starships (DCI Day 2)''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[KypDuron]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-14140">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14140 Training & Starships (DCI Day 2)], DeckTech (The Real "KypDuron" KilleR, 1 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14140/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14140/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018041625/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14140/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[KypDuron]]

* '''Published title:''' ''Training & Starships (DCI Day 2)''
